_notes.defaultMode: Was 'bypassPermissions', which runs EVERYTHING without asking. Set to 'auto', where a safety classifier approves routine calls and stops risky ones. To revert: change this line and add 'skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt': true. NOTE the PowerShell wrapper in terminal/powershell/profile.ps1 passes --dangerously-skip-permissions, which overrides this from the command line.
_notes.allow: The old config had 217 rules, nearly all single-project one-offs pinned to directory paths that no longer exist. The 24 that work in any repo survived.
_notes.skillOverrides: The 176 unused skills get disabled here. Full list is in skills.md; install.ps1 generates the block so this file doesn't carry 176 hardcoded lines.
_notes.hooks_and_statusLine: Installed by oh-my-claudecode (omc-setup). Not hardcoded here because OMC rewrites that section on every update.
